t: When someone you love will not listen
a: إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِى مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
p: Innaka lā tahdī man aḥbabta wa lākinna-llāha yahdī man yashā'…
m: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allāh guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
